historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment anchored on revenue_3yr_cagr (5.1%) less the social-entertainment drag; base-case mid-horizon growth
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 18.6% and owner-FCF 3yr CAGR 14.4% diverge >30% from revenue 3yr CAGR 5.1%: FY2023-25 was a margin-expansion story (pre-SBC EBITDA margin 23.5% -> 35.7%), not a top-line one, and that expansion is already in the base margin. FY2025 EPS (RMB7.11/ADS) carries a RMB2,440m one-off investment gain; ex-gain EPS CAGRs are roughly 25% (3yr) / 18% (5yr). Equity and EPS CAGRs are therefore NOT used as the growth proxy.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income) are ABOVE reported-FCF CAGRs (14.4% vs 12.0% 3yr; 18.0% vs 15.6% 5yr): SBC has been flat at ~RMB0.65-0.85bn while cash flow doubled, so SBC is a shrinking share of FCF -- the opposite of the SBC-outgrowing-cash warning. FY2021 owner FCF (1,198) is depressed by RMB2,758m of content-license capex; FY2020->FY2025 5yr CAGR reads 18% partly because FY2020 was a cash-tax and capex-heavy base.

scenario_narratives.base: Music related services keep growing mid-single digit: the SVIP tier (>15m) lifts ARPPU while the casual paying base is flat against ByteDance's free Qishui/Soda Music, and offline performances/merchandise add lumpy but real revenue. Social entertainment keeps shrinking ~12%/yr under the 2022 live-streaming rules until it is a rounding error. Ximalaya (RMB~3.4bn run-rate, barely profitable) annualises in FY2027 and dilutes margin by ~0.7pp before integration efficiencies claw it back; the SAMR conditions (no price rises, no free-content cuts, no new exclusives) mean no quick monetisation. Pre-SBC EBITDA margin drifts from 35.5% to 37% -- the FY2023-25 expansion is kept, not extended. Cash tax 18%, capex 3.6%, 11% CNY cost of equity, 2.5% terminal growth.
scenario_narratives.bull: SVIP penetration and ARPPU (RMB11.9 at last disclosure) compound at high single digits, Ximalaya's audio library is bundled into SVIP and its margin converges toward the group's, K-pop content (SM Entertainment stake) and Weixin XiaoWei AI distribution add low-cost users, and social entertainment stabilises as the regulatory reset completes. Revenue grows ~10% in FY2027 fading to 3% by year 10; operating leverage carries the pre-SBC EBITDA margin to 41% (the FY2023-25 trajectory continued at half the pace). Cash tax 17%, capex 3.4%, terminal growth 3%.
scenario_narratives.bear: ByteDance's free, Douyin-fed Soda Music (MAU +69% YoY, approaching QQ Music's scale) forces TME to defend the paying base with price and free-tier concessions: music revenue declines ~3%/yr for two years, social entertainment falls another ~18%/yr, advertising is hit by macro, and Ximalaya stays flat under its antitrust conditions. Content-cost inflation on label renewals (no exclusivity leverage) plus revenue-share floors compress the pre-SBC EBITDA margin from 34% back to 27% -- below FY2024's 31.7%. Growth returns only to 2% by year 8; HNTE preferential tax status partly lapses (20% cash tax). The RMB44bn cash pile and RMB19bn of listed stakes still underpin ~RMB29/ADS of value, which is why even this path sits above a price that implies the operating business is worth ~4x FCF.

valuation_philosophy.summary: House owner-FCF basis: SBC (RMB680m, 2% of revenue) fully expensed and the ADS count held flat; interest income on the RMB44bn cash pile stripped from the flows and the cash added once in the bridge; the RMB22.8bn investment portfolio (FVOCI stakes, associates, other) added at 85% because its income is outside EBITDA; NCI deducted once at book; leases charged as an operating cost with lease liabilities excluded from debt. Flows and WACC are both in CNY; per-ADS values are converted to USD at the dated CNY=X rate and parity-checked against 1698.HK. A 10-year explicit horizon is used because Ximalaya annualisation and the social-entertainment run-off distort years 1-3. Terminal value is Gordon capped at 15x FCF. Jurisdiction risk is charged in the 11% rate, operating risk in the 30/50/20 weights -- each once.
key_risks_to_valuation: Competition: ByteDance Soda/Qishui Music's free model eroding TME's paying ratio and pricing power -- the bear axis; paying-user and ARPPU disclosure was discontinued in 2026 so the signal is now indirect

Regulatory: PRC content/live-streaming rules, anti-monopoly conditions on Ximalaya, VIE structure, HFCAA residual -- priced in the 3pp country premium, but a step-change (e.g. forced divestiture) is not in any scenario

Bridge dependence: ~RMB47bn (cash 27.7bn net + investments 19.4bn after haircut) is ~RMB29/ADS (~US$4.4), more than half the current price; the FVOCI stakes are marked to volatile listed prices (fell RMB7bn in H1 2026)
Currency: CNY flows against a USD quote; a 5% RMB depreciation moves every USD value 5%, and refresh_price.py moves the price but not fx_rate (dated 2026-10-04)
Share count is derived (1,594m diluted ADS +/-0.6%) from the Q2 weighted average; replace with the 20-F / HKEX monthly-return period-end count when available
Anchor timing: H2 2026 FCF (~US$0.35/ADS) omitted by using the June balance sheet with an FY2026E base -- conservative, but a reader comparing to a Dec-2026 balance sheet will see the gap

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (TME) at inputs.price_as_of, regular close; 52-week range 7.66-23.855. FX: Yahoo CNY=X and HKD=X at the timestamps in inputs.fx_note; HKEX parity via 1698.HK.
data_sources.financials: research/TME/Reports/TME_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, CNY millions, per-ADS EPS); TME_Annual_FY2025.txt (20-F: SBC reconciliation, interest income, cash taxes paid, capex, lease principal, buybacks, D&A); TME_Quarterly_Q2-2026.txt (6-K: 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet, share counts, Ximalaya RMB407m contribution, segment revenue, buyback detail)
data_sources.qualitative: research/TME/Reports/TME_Analysis.json (2026-10-04): business model, competitive position, Ximalaya deal terms and SAMR conditions, Q2 2026 guidance commentary, bull/bear cases

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E (fy0). H1 2026 actual 16,828 (incl. RMB407m Ximalaya from 18 May) + H2 2026E 19,072 = core H2 2025 17,104 x 1.017 (music related ~+5%, social entertainment ~-15%) + Ximalaya ~1,700 (RMB407m/44 days annualised to ~3,375/yr). Reported growth +9.1%, organic ~+2.7%.
inputs.shares_basis: ADS (1 ADS = 2 Class A ordinary shares), millions, fully diluted. Derived period-end 30 Jun 2026: Q2 weighted diluted 1,575.6m ADS (Q2-2026 6-K) rolled forward for the 76.9m ADS (153.8m shares) issued to Ximalaya holders on 18 May 2026 and the 43.5m ADS repurchased during the quarter, plus 11.4m diluted-basic gap = ~1,594m (+/-10m). All per-share outputs are per ADS, matching the NYSE quote.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted ADS, held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). The Ximalaya issuance was genuine non-SBC acquisition currency and is already in the 30 Jun 2026 count. Buybacks (RMB ~2.9bn / US$400m in Q2 2026 alone; RMB 1,249m / 1,853m / 462m in FY2023-25) comfortably fund the flat count -- TME is a net repurchaser, so the flat count is paid for, not a convention.
inputs.total_debt_note: 30 Jun 2026: borrowings 5,997 current + 7,142 non-current (new, drawn to fund the Ximalaya cash consideration) + notes payable 3,390 = 16,529. Lease liabilities (137 + 218 = 355) EXCLUDED under lease treatment (B).
inputs.cash_note: 30 Jun 2026: cash 23,698 + current term deposits 6,761 + non-current term deposits 13,640 + short-term investments 123 = 44,222 (the company's own 'cash, cash equivalents, term deposits and short-term investments' total). Investments at FVOCI, equity-method associates and other investments are NOT in cash; they are in equity_bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F non-IFRS reconciliation 'share-based compensation expenses' RMB680m (cash-flow add-back RMB669m; equity-award taxes paid RMB281m recorded separately in Metrics.csv and not summed on top, per the house combined-figure rule)
inputs.buyback_cash_note: FY2025 repurchase of ordinary shares RMB462m (20-F FY2025 line 8776). Pace has since stepped up sharply: 43.5m ADS for ~US$400m (~RMB2.9bn) in Q2 2026 alone.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); NYSE ADS quoted in USD. fx_rate is CNY->USD = 1/6.7048 (Yahoo CNY=X, 2026-10-04T03:30Z). Parity check against the HKEX dual primary listing: 1698.HK HK$30.94 (2026-10-02 close) x 2 shares per ADS / 7.8463 HKD per USD (Yahoo HKD=X) = US$7.89 per ADS implied by the HK quote, within 2% of the NYSE close recorded in current_price at inputs.price_as_of (the gap is the 12-hour close difference) -- confirms direction, ADS ratio and quote basis. Unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are USD per ADS; *_cny twins are RMB per ADS.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-02T20:00:03Z regular close (Friday); not an after-hours print
inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY-denominated flows discounted at an 11.0% CNY cost of equity (net cash, so WACC = cost of equity): 10y China government bond ~1.8% + beta 1.15 x 8.0% (mature-market ERP 5.0% + 3.0% China country/jurisdiction premium covering VIE enforceability, PRC content and anti-monopoly regulation, HFCAA residual and geopolitical discount). Risk is charged once: jurisdiction risk lives in the rate; operating risk (ByteDance competition, social-entertainment decline, Ximalaya execution) lives in the scenario flows and weights. Same WACC in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost: full lease payment (FY2025 principal RMB124m + lease interest ~RMB10m = ~0.4% of revenue) charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB355m) excluded from net debt. D&A path (4.0%) is ex right-of-use depreciation so the lease is not charged twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are 100% consolidated (TME non-IFRS EBITDA basis); non-controlling interests deducted ONCE in the bridge at 30 Jun 2026 book value RMB2,801m. NCI took RMB297m of FY2025 profit (2.6%); at the base terminal multiple that is worth ~RMB3.5-4bn, so book modestly understates the leakage (~RMB0.5-0.7/ADS, ~US$0.1).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company: consumer-internet subscription + advertising + live-streaming; not a bank/REIT/LIC). First valuation of this ticker, no memory entry. EBITDA basis: TME's own adjusted EBITDA (operating profit excl. interest income and other gains, + D&A) BEFORE SBC -- the Metrics.csv 'ebitda' column is after SBC (kpi AdjustedEBITDAIncSBC), so ebitda_margin_path here = (csv ebitda + sbc)/revenue: FY2024 31.7%, FY2025 35.7%, H1 2026 36.2% (Q2 2026 36.4%). Interest income (RMB1,054m FY2025) is stripped from last_fcf and is not inside the EBITDA margin, so the RMB44.2bn cash pile is counted once (in net debt). Investment income/gains (RMB2,632m FY2025, incl. a RMB2,440m one-off Q1 2025 gain) are outside EBITDA, so the investment portfolio enters the bridge at a haircut (matching-asset rule). ANCHOR TIMING: fy0 = FY2026E with the 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet, so H2 2026 owner FCF (~RMB3.5-4bn, ~US$0.35/ADS) is neither in net cash nor in the discounted flows -- a deliberate conservative omission; Q3 2026 buybacks since June lower both cash and the count and are roughly value-neutral. KPI DISCLOSURE: TME stopped printing paying users and ARPPU in 2026 (kpis end Q4 2025: MAU 528m, ARPPU RMB11.9), so subscriber growth is inferred: Q2 2026 organic membership revenue ex-Ximalaya grew ~+4%. Owner-FCF history (reported FCF - SBC recon - interest income): FY2018 4,719; FY2019 4,780; FY2020 3,192; FY2021 1,198; FY2022 4,883; FY2023 4,385; FY2024 7,366; FY2025 7,309.

base.growth_note: Y1 (FY2027) +6.5% = ~3.7pp Ximalaya annualisation (RMB2.1bn in FY2026E -> ~3.45bn) + core +3% (music related +5.5% on SVIP/ARPPU and offline performances, social entertainment -12%). Thereafter ~3.5% as social shrinks toward 10% of revenue and music grows mid-single digit; converging to 2.5% terminal.
base.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-SBC adjusted EBITDA margin. H1 2026 36.2%; FY2027 dipped to 35.5% for a full year of lower-margin Ximalaya and offline-performance mix (CFO guided a slight H2 2026 gross-margin decline), then +1.5pp over the decade from Ximalaya integration efficiencies and the mix shift away from revenue-shared social entertainment. No return to the FY2023-25 pace of expansion.
base.da_note: FY2025 D&A 4.2% of revenue incl. ~0.4% right-of-use depreciation; 4.0% ex-ROU. Ximalaya acquisition-intangible amortisation (non-cash, largely non-deductible) deliberately not added so no phantom tax shield.
base.capex_note: FY2025 PPE 305 + intangibles 883 = 1,188 = 3.6% of revenue; FY2024 3.6%; FY2023 2.2%.
base.cash_tax_note: Cash taxes paid / EBIT after D&A: FY2023 17.3%, FY2024 18.4%, FY2025 18.8%. Blend of 15% HNTE preferential rate on key subsidiaries and 25% statutory elsewhere plus withholding. Held flat.
base.wc_note: Deferred revenue grows with subscription bookings (3,275 -> 3,842 in FY2025, ~12% of the revenue increase) but content prepayments offset: working capital was ~+1.8bn in FY2024 and ~-0.7bn in FY2025. 5% capture on the revenue change is a modest net positive.
base.terminal_note: Cap 15x (not the 20x compounder default): single-market Chinese media name with regulatory exposure. At 11%/2.5% Gordon = 12.1x, so Gordon binds.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: the competitive share-loss thesis is live and visible in the numbers (organic Q2 2026 revenue +1%, membership ex-Ximalaya ~+4%, paying-user and ARPPU disclosure withdrawn in 2026), the company answers to a single regulator that has already forced divestiture of exclusives and attached behavioural conditions to Ximalaya, and three sell-side houses cut targets after a beat. Bull cut from 35% to 20% because it needs ARPPU, Ximalaya synergies and social stabilisation all to land at once. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
